content: The model trained on one-way translations is slightly better than the one trained on round-trip translations. As expected, VP ellipsis is the hardest phenomena to be captured using round-trip translations, and the DocRepair model trained on one-way translated data gains 6% accuracy on this test set. This shows that the DocRepair model benefits from having access to non-synthetic English data. This results in exposing DocRepair at training time to Russian translations which suffer from the same inconsistencies as the ones it will have to correct at test time.
